name: 66_en_negative_controls_r3
description: Round 3 negative control (EN). Ordinary capitalised sentence starts, unit and warehouse words as common nouns, the lower-case word 'phone' without a number, 'sort code and account' without numbers, clause references with slashes and day ranges. Nothing is masked.

blocks.text: 1.1. Delivery follows payment. Payment follows invoice.
1.2. Warehouse staff must sign for goods on arrival.
1.3. Unit prices are fixed for the whole term.
1.4. Notices must be in writing. Questions will be answered within 5 days.
1.5. The phone number is printed on the policy schedule.
1.6. Authorised persons may sign. Managing Director approval is required.
1.7. Sort code and account details are shown on the invoice.
1.8. See clause 4.2/b and annex 3/1 for the procedure.
1.9. Payment is due within 14-30 days after the invoice.
